skill.summary: Set up and monitor bandwidth-sharing nodes on Grass.io, Mysterium, Storj, and Honeygain to earn passive crypto income with automated alerts and ROI tracking.

latestVersion.changelog:
bandwidth-income skill initial release:

- Guides users to set up and manage bandwidth-sharing nodes for Grass.io, Mysterium Network, Storj, and Honeygain via Docker.
- Provides commands for node setup, status checks, earning tracking, monitoring with alerts, and node restarts.
- Includes an all-in-one Docker Compose example for deployment.
- Features earning calculators and platform comparisons.
- Offers a sample monitoring script for automatic uptime checks and restarts.
- Lists requirements, earnings estimates, and best practices for privacy and safety.
